note: Codex read all 100 development titles and bodies; provisional symptom annotations, not human ground truth. No audit bodies were opened for this annotation.

rationales.0: Startup crash is explicit; body does not establish a memory root cause.
rationales.1: Sanitizer member-call diagnostic after a resolution change; termination is not reported.
rationales.2: Ship design state is duplicated each turn.
rationales.3: Mission eligibility incorrectly accepts uninstalled equipment in cargo.
rationales.4: Battlefield objects are drawn at an incorrect screen location.
rationales.5: Hero-screen information omits a morale modifier.
rationales.6: Only a fog-of-war title and image link; text does not distinguish rendering from visibility rules.
rationales.7: A code-condition defect is described but its player-facing symptom is unspecified.
rationales.8: Explicit segmentation fault after throwing a rock.
rationales.9: Mobile RTL dialog positioning is incorrect.
rationales.10: Keyboard interaction in the asset-browser editor UI regressed.
rationales.11: Editor selection/copy state retains removed objects; classify interaction with tooling context.
rationales.12: Mesh backs are visible through wall-mounted objects; geometry/visual defect.
rationales.13: Collision/hitscan behavior incorrectly depends on corpse state.
rationales.14: Nationalization and recurring income rules are not applied.
rationales.15: Company-closing action returns an error; whole-application termination is not stated.
rationales.16: Decorative rain timing does not follow game-time slowdown.
rationales.17: Russian report describes effect/camera offsets on screen.
rationales.18: Share ownership/presidency state after a sale is wrong.
rationales.19: Targeting exploit kills unspawned players; desync is additional context, not established root cause.
rationales.20: Cell-editor color-picker ranges and conversion are incorrect.
rationales.21: Explosion triggers server shutdown and an aborted Lua error.
rationales.22: Localized threat-level text contains a typo.
rationales.23: Resistance sound plays under inappropriate spell conditions.
rationales.24: Boss state/behavior after semi-death is wrong, beyond visual appearance alone.
rationales.25: Refueling interaction fails with contradictory feedback.
rationales.26: Beatmap-editor mouse placement inserts the note at the wrong tick.
rationales.27: Standalone asset extractor produces transparent output, not an observed in-game render failure.
rationales.28: Boot sprite fails to update with activation state.
rationales.30: Shop resale-price multiplier permits an unintended profit loop.
rationales.31: Profile activity summary merges incompatible game categories; displayed summary is the reported impact.
rationales.32: Company ability is available in an incorrect phase.
rationales.33: Crit/dead player can move under specific weightless conditions.
rationales.34: Gravity remains after deleting its generator.
rationales.35: Flying entities are gated by research state; desired rule is partly a design proposal.
rationales.36: Multiple complaints, but the principal title/body concern is rule/currency values.
rationales.37: Application fails to start with an unhandled initialization/library exception.
rationales.38: AI order-generation script raises an in-game diagnostic; the report does not say the whole application exits.
rationales.39: Refinancing action is unavailable despite the stated rules.
rationales.40: Runtime-error log exists but resulting player-visible termination or failure is not described.
rationales.41: Explicit crash or freeze at AI end turn.
rationales.42: Quest progress fails for a max-level item.
rationales.43: A rules action is blocked by an error, not a stated whole-application crash.
rationales.44: Title reports elimination-majority logic including nonparticipants; body is empty.
rationales.45: Card-note UI is obscured by a blank-image precedence issue.
rationales.46: Persistent gray overlay after switching apps; UI/window context is more likely than world rendering.
rationales.47: Restart/mod launching loads the wrong engine/mod environment.
rationales.48: Explicit crash while loading/entering a map; save-state reproduction context.
rationales.49: Armory lockers have unintended destruction thresholds.
rationales.50: Population/extinction state can become invalid across patches.
rationales.51: Title describes map spawn locations not centered; visual evidence is not inspected.
rationales.52: PR-template reference cleanup, not a software failure report; keep as selection noise.
rationales.53: Japanese report: configured result-screen motion is not applied for a custom gauge.
rationales.54: Line-of-sight/build interaction prevents building through windows.
rationales.56: Redundant user messages; whether this is a bug or enhancement is ambiguous.
rationales.57: Explicit assertion-triggered crash with save-based reproduction.
rationales.58: Independent localization and server-crash complaints; title does not identify a primary symptom.
rationales.59: Plugin-view icons fail to display under high-DPI conditions.
rationales.60: Synchronization authority proposal without a concrete observed failure; bug status and main symptom remain uncertain.
rationales.61: Game-phase tile choices do not match the stated rules.
rationales.62: Crosshair/HUD placement is not retained across maps; primary impact is HUD configuration.

rationales.64: Morale penalty is applied at an incorrect turn phase.
